main.description: A bidirectional binding between an AT Protocol identity and an xNet did:key. Holding this record proves the AT Protocol account vouches for the xNet key; the signature proves the xNet key vouches back. Neither half alone proves anything.

xnetDid.description: The xNet data identity (did:key) this account vouches for.

atprotoDid.description: The AT Protocol identity the xNet key vouches for. Must match the repo this record lives in.

sig.description:
base64url Ed25519 signature by the xNet key over `xnet-atproto-binding.v1
<xnetDid>
<atprotoDid>
<createdAt>`.
